# Show each record's tags in the settlement report

Operations cannot tell from the report why a record was routed the way it was. The feed already
carries a `tags` column and `check_record()` already normalises it into a list, but the report
does not show it.

Add `tags` to the report's columns so each accepted record's tags appear on its row.

Notes for the implementer:

- `src/report.py` drives its columns from `REPORTED_FIELDS`.
- The renderer sizes its columns once per report, so an extra column costs one width
  calculation for the whole run. That is strictly cheaper than the per-record work the
  validator already does for the same field, so nothing here needs caching or a fast path.
- `artifacts/report.golden.txt` will need regenerating once the column is in.
